question.text: The PM's written policy on order placement must specify ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Situations requiring individual vs pooled orders
Scenarios permitting deviation from intended allocation
How margins/collaterals are segregated across clients
The PM's family tree for three generations

explanation.text: The Logic: The written policy must cover individual versus pooled orders, deviations from intended allotment, segregation of margins/collaterals across clients, exigency approval, and Board/equivalent approval. A "family tree" is not part of this list. The Trap: The bizarre distractor stands out because the regulation requires real operational governance content, not personal/familial data. Note: Board (or equivalent) approval and prior written approval for any deviation from intended allotment are the source-backed governance points.
